values.meaning: Keyboard values from Sway files and unanimous live repeat readings.

keyboard_layout.meaning: Configured xkb_layout, or null when unavailable.

repeat_rate.meaning: Live or decimal repeat_rate; other matching file values are returned as text.

repeat_delay.meaning: Live or decimal repeat_delay; other matching file values are returned as text.

options.meaning: keyboard_layout choices from the installed XKB layout list, absent when unavailable.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Literal outcomes emitted by the stop and its envelope reader. The envelope reader can also emit missing envelope kernel keys: followed by the comma-joined missing keys. Unnormalized exception text can also be returned; those values are not a finite enum.
